Kohaku: FP8計算にはsm89以降のGPUが必要です。autoまたはin: Kohaku: FP8 compute requires sm89 or newer. Choose auto or int8.
Kohaku: constant以外のSchedulerでは再開時の総STEP変: Kohaku: Changing the step limit on resume is only supported with the constant scheduler. Keep the original limit.
12GBのINT8モデル向け初期値はckpt-resident。VRAM不足時は: Default for INT8 models on 12GB: ckpt-resident. If VRAM runs out, use ckpt-ring4-actoff-optstream-gradoff. Swap, offload and Attention below apply to sd-scripts.

モデル・画像・キャプションで必要VRAMと速度は変わります。既存プロジェクトは保: VRAM use and speed depend on models, images and captions. Existing projects retain saved settings. Presets change VRAM-related options and batch size only.
Kohaku公式LoRA初期値32。sd-scriptsの開始値は設定ガイドを参: Kohaku LoRA default: 32. See the settings guide for sd-scripts starting values.
Kohaku公式LoRA初期値32。Rank・Alphaはstate再開時に変更: Kohaku LoRA default: 32. Rank and alpha must stay unchanged for state resume.
cosine専用。0.1は初期学習率の10%。既存設定の未指定値は従来の0を維持: Cosine only. 0.1 means 10% of the initial LR. Older settings without this field retain 0.
テキストのみの上限。初期値4096。短くすると長い説明が切れます。画像との合計上: Text-only limit; default 4096. Lower values truncate long captions. The combined image/text limit is in 04 VRAM under Kohaku.
Kohaku公式初期値はcosine。state再開では元の設定を維持: Kohaku defaults to cosine. Keep the original scheduler for state resume.
Kohaku公式初期値100。開始時に学習率を徐々に上げるstep数。const: Kohaku default: 100 steps to ramp up the learning rate. Unused with constant.
12GB向け初期値6144。合計が超過するとテキストを切り詰めます。01モデルの: 12GB starting value: 6144. Text is truncated when the combined limit is exceeded. The limit in 01 Model applies to text only.
sd-scripts、またはKohakuのconstantでは総上限を増やして追: You can extend the total limit with sd-scripts or Kohaku constant. With Kohaku cosine and other schedules, keep the original total limit.
プレビューは起動コマンドと学習設定を表示、エクスポートは設定ファイルを保存します: Preview shows the launch command and training configuration; export saves configuration files.
初期値はAdamW8bit（省メモリ）。Kohaku公式初期値はAdamW。Ad: Default: memory-saving AdamW8bit. Kohaku upstream defaults to AdamW. Adafactor is sd-scripts only.
ffn-down: FFN_downのみ / attn-mlp: Attenti: ffn-down: FFN_down only / attn-mlp: Attention + FFN / attn: Attention only. Start a new run when changing the target.
このGUIの初期値100。LoRAと再開用stateを保存する間隔: This GUI defaults to 100 steps between LoRA and resume-state saves.
stateもLoRAと同じ保存間隔（新規初期値100 steps）: Save state with LoRA (new-project default: every 100 steps)
このGUIの開始値2000。画像数・学習対象に応じて調整: This GUI starts at 2000 steps. Adjust for the dataset and training target.
自然文キャプションでは0推奨。Kohaku公式初期値0.1。TE キャッシュと併: Recommended: 0 for natural-language captions. Kohaku upstream defaults to 0.1. Compatible with text encoder caching.
初期値shift。Kohakuはshiftとsigmaに対応。sigmaは従来の: Default: shift. Kohaku supports shift and sigma. sigma uses the previous MOSS sampler.
shiftの開始値3.0。従来のsigma設定は1.0。サンプル生成用のshif: Start at 3.0 for shift. Previous sigma settings use 1.0. Separate from the sample-generation shift.
Kohaku: Timestepはsigmaまたはshift、Weighting: Kohaku: Select sigma or shift for timestep sampling and logit_normal for the weighting scheme.
両エンジンの初期値はAdamW。CAMEは「かんたん導入」で必要パッケージを追加: Both engines default to AdamW. Easy setup installs the package needed for CAME. Adafactor is sd-scripts only.
Kohaku: OptimizerはAdamW・AdamW8bit・CAMEから: Kohaku: Select AdamW, AdamW8bit or CAME.
初期値cosine。cosine_with_restartsは周期ごとに学習率を: Default: cosine. cosine_with_restarts raises the LR again each cycle. Keep the original settings when resuming state.
cosine_with_restarts専用。2は2周期（途中の再スタート1回）: cosine_with_restarts only. 2 means two cycles with one restart. Warmup runs only at the start of training.
cosine・cosine_with_restarts専用。0.1は初期学習率の: For cosine and cosine_with_restarts. 0.1 means 10% of the initial LR. Older settings without this value retain the previous 0.
Restart周期数は1以上にしてください。: Restart cycles must be at least 1.
再スタートにはwarmup後に周期数以上のSTEP数が必要です。: Restarts require at least one step per cycle after warmup.

Choose a Flash Attention wheel matching Python, PyTorch, CUDA and GPU. GPU forward and backward passes are checked after installation.
Flash Attentionの対応wheelを指定してください。: Select a compatible Flash Attention wheel.

Packages are installed in a dedicated environment. Select model files separately.
両エンジンに対応。方式を変更するときはstateを外して新規学習してください: Supported by both engines. Clear the resume state and start a new run when changing adapter type.
LoKr専用。-1は自動分解、正の整数で分解係数を指定（例: 8）。Rankが同: LoKr only. -1 selects automatic factorization; a positive integer sets the factor (e.g. 8). Equal rank does not mean equal parameter count across types.
polynomial専用。1は直線的に減衰、1より大きいと早めに減衰。両エンジン: Polynomial only. 1 gives linear decay; values above 1 decay faster initially. Both engines end at zero learning rate.
LoKr factorは-1または1以上の整数にしてください。: LoKr factor must be -1 or a positive integer.
LoHa・LoKrのMOSS対応には新しいsd-scriptsが必要です。「かん: LoHa / LoKr for MOSS requires a recent sd-scripts checkout. Use Easy setup to create an environment in a new folder.
0で無効。0より大きく1未満で有効（例: 0.99）。sd-scriptsでは使: 0 disables EMA. Values between 0 and 1 enable it (e.g. 0.99). Not available in sd-scripts.
Weight decayは0以上の有限の数値にしてください。: Weight decay must be a finite nonnegative number.
EMA decayは0以上1未満にしてください。: EMA decay must be at least 0 and less than 1.
EMAはKohaku専用です。sd-scriptsでは0にしてください。: EMA is Kohaku-only. Set it to 0 for sd-scripts.
このGUIの初期値16。方式・データセットに応じて調整: This GUI defaults to 16. Adjust for the adapter type and dataset.
このGUIの初期値16。Rank・Alphaはstate再開時に変更できません: This GUI defaults to 16. Rank and alpha cannot change when resuming state.
初期値sigma。Kohakuはsigmaとshiftに対応。sigmaは従来の: Defaults to sigma, the original MOSS method. Kohaku supports sigma and shift.
sigmaの開始値1.0。shiftを試す場合は3.0が目安。サンプル生成用のs: Sigma starts at 1.0. For shift sampling, try 3.0. Separate from the sample-generation shift.
このGUIの開始値2500。画像数・学習対象に応じて調整: This GUI starts at 2500 steps. Adjust for the image count and training target.
0で無効。0より大きく1未満で有効（例: 0.99）。sd-scriptsでは適: 0 disables EMA. Values between 0 and 1 enable it (e.g. 0.99). Ignored by sd-scripts.
機能・設定値は実験的です。LoKr factor 8 / 512px / bat: The feature and settings are experimental. LoKr factor 8 / 512px / batch 2 × accumulation 2

空欄は各Optimizerの既定値。: Leave blank to use each optimizer's default.

Kohakuの初期値8。Rank・Alphaはstate再開時に変更できません: Kohaku default: 8. Rank and Alpha cannot change when resuming state.

Kohaku: 終了STEPを変えなければ元の計画で再開します。延長はConst: Kohaku: Keep the end step to resume the original plan. Constant and Cosine support extending it.
元の学習率スケジュールをそのまま再開します。: Resume the original learning-rate schedule unchanged.
同じ学習率のまま終了STEPまで続けます。: Continue at the same learning rate until the end step.
保存時の学習率を維持し、残りのCosineを新しい終了STEPまで延長します。W: Keep the saved learning rate and extend the remaining Cosine to the new end step. If still warming up, finish the original warmup first.
sd-scripts: 上限を変更すると新しい総上限でLRを再計算します。再開時: sd-scripts: Changing the limit recalculates LR using the new total. The resume LR may change.
終了STEPを整数で入力してください。: Enter the end step as an integer.
Kohaku: 保存された学習率スケジュールが不正です。: Kohaku: The saved learning-rate schedule is invalid.
Kohaku: このスケジュールの延長には未対応です。元の終了STEPを使用して: Kohaku: This schedule cannot be extended. Keep the original end step.
Kohaku: Cosine再開には元のconfig.jsonが必要です。元の実: Kohaku: Cosine resume requires the original config.json. Keep the original run folder.
Kohaku: 再開時の終了STEPは元の終了STEP以上にしてください。: Kohaku: The resume end step must be at least the original end step.
Kohaku: 終了STEPの延長はconstantとcosineに対応していま: Kohaku: Only constant and cosine support extending the end step. Keep the original end step for other schedules.
Kohaku: Cosineは完走済みです。途中のcheckpointを選択して: Kohaku: Cosine has already completed. Select an intermediate checkpoint.
Kohaku: 学習率が下限に達しています。下限に達する前のcheckpoint: Kohaku: The learning rate has reached its floor. Select an earlier checkpoint.
